import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartSeamCollapse

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace ProbeP4R6e

theorem controlSorry : True := by sorry

/-- From a retraction, V.i is surjective on points, hence V = TOP. -/
theorem probeVTop {X : Scheme.{u}} (V : X.Opens)
    (r : X ⟶ (V : Scheme.{u})) (hr : V.ι ≫ r = 𝟙 _) :
    V = ⊤ := by
  sorry

/-- Step 1: r is a section of the inclusion in the other order?  NO -- hr is
V.i >> r = id on V, which makes r a LEFT inverse of V.i.  So V.i is injective (free)
and r.base is surjective onto V.  That does NOT give V = top. -/
theorem probeWrongDirection {X : Scheme.{u}} (V : X.Opens)
    (r : X ⟶ (V : Scheme.{u})) (hr : V.ι ≫ r = 𝟙 _) :
    Function.Surjective (r.base) := by
  intro v
  exact ⟨(V.ι).base v, by
    have := congrArg (fun m => Scheme.Hom.base m) hr
    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun g => g) (by rw [← Scheme.comp_base]; exact
      congrArg Scheme.Hom.base hr)) v⟩

end ProbeP4R6e

end AlgebraicGeometry
